plan.one_liner: Think like a chess grandmaster: see five moves ahead in your career and business.
plan.summary: Patrick Bet-David, who rose from immigrant roots to found a large financial services firm, argues that success in business comes from thinking like a chess player. Most people react to the next move. Winners anticipate several moves ahead. The book is organized around five areas to master. First, know yourself: what you truly want, who you are, and the person you are trying to become. Second, sharpen your ability to reason, so you can process problems calmly and make sound decisions. Third, build a strategy to grow. Fourth, assemble and lead the right team, with clear values and accountability. Fifth, learn power plays that let smaller players outmaneuver bigger ones. Throughout, Bet-David blends personal stories with practical frameworks, insisting that strategy is a learnable skill rather than a talent.

lessons.title: Think Five Moves Ahead
lessons.key_idea: Like a chess grandmaster, you win by anticipating the consequences of each move rather than reacting to the one in front of you.

lessons.title: Know Exactly What You Want
lessons.key_idea: Strategy starts with self-awareness, because you need a clear picture of who you are and who you want to become before you can plan any moves.

lessons.title: Process Problems, Don't React
lessons.key_idea: Strong decision-makers slow down, find the real issue, and reason through options instead of acting on emotion.

lessons.title: Build a Plan to Grow
lessons.key_idea: Growth comes from deliberate strategy, with systems and speed that let a business scale instead of stalling.

lessons.title: Win Through the Right People
lessons.key_idea: No strategy works without a team that shares your values, so hire carefully and build a culture of accountability.

lessons.title: Play Power Moves Like a Pro
lessons.key_idea: By combining self-knowledge, clear reasoning, a growth plan and a strong team, even smaller players can outmaneuver bigger competitors.
